summary: Expanded the universe around the compliance-infrastructure side of politicized trade: global trade management software, denied-party/sanctions screening, customs brokerage, supply-chain traceability, and inspection/compliance data. The strongest underfollowed fit is Descartes Systems because its product set maps directly to denied-party screening, customs filings, tariff/duty content, and trade data. UL Solutions is less tariff-specific but relevant as a public testing/inspection/compliance platform with supply-chain compliance and transparency software. Expeditors is a reference logistics/customs brokerage beneficiary. Thomson Reuters is a reference software/data incumbent through ONESOURCE Global Trade, but broader and higher-attention.
